dex.entry: The fully kindled form — a magnificent reef-fish whose entire body is a living prism. Light bends through it into weapons. The crystalline fish that turns any battlefield into a light show.

art.silhouette: Majestic, long-bodied fish with translucent crystalline fins that refract all light into dazzling arcs, pale blue-white body with thin crystalline armour plates, twin feeler-fins curled like antennae, piercing white eyes.
art.palette: Majestic, long-bodied fish with translucent crystalline fins that refract all light into dazzling arcs, pale blue-white body with thin crystalline armour plates, twin feeler-fins curled like antennae, piercing white eyes.
art.direction: The crystalline fish that turns any battlefield into a light show. Trainers use it for style points as much as power.
